{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
[[File:Obi-Wan_Kenobi_SWG4.jpg|thumb|right|250px|High Jedi General Obi-Wan Kenobi]]
A '''High Jedi General''', also referred to as '''Jedi High General''', was the highest rank&mdash;short of becoming [[Master of the Order/Legends|Master of the Order]] or the [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]&mdash;that a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] could obtain during the course of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Only members of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] qualified for the rank. High Jedi Generals held command over one of the ten [[Systems Army/Legends|Systems Armies]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="GGAR">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref>

[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]],<ref name="LDGG">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Lightsaber Duels: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Lightsaber Duels'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]],<ref name="TFUn">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref> [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]],<ref name="TFUCG">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]<ref name="GGAR" /> were all High Jedi Generals.
